card.name: Chemistry terms before a continuing word
card.fires_on: Chemical or science words that are likely to be followed by more of the same term, such as 'nitrous gas', 'CO2', and partway through names like estradiol or trastuzumab. It also fires on a few linking words in drug or lab text.

modes.label: Chemical names and formulas
modes.description: A gas, formula or compound name where the next piece continues the term.
modes.example: An atom of nitrous acid, 1 nitric acid + 1 nitrous<< gas>>

modes.label: Partway through drug or science words
modes.description: A middle or ending piece of a long drug or chemistry word.

modes.label: Small words in lab or label text
modes.description: A short word such as 'of' or 'live' in a concentration or vaccine phrase.
modes.example: concentration of 20 mg/mL<< of>> allopurinol. Inspect
